profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Kenzo is a passionate and self-motivated Software Engineer with a relentless drive to effect positive change through innovative solutions. With a profound expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, and the React ecosystem, Kenzo is dedicated to optimizing codebases, crafting robust testing strategies, and supporting cross-functional teams. His track record showcases a remarkable ability to curate exceptional user experiences while upholding code readability, scalability, and accessibility, earning him acclaim within renowned companies. 

His collaborative spirit, coupled with a shared vision, shines when engaging with colleagues and clients alike. Kenzo's hallmark communication skills and unwavering enthusiasm seamlessly blend to drive success.In Kenzo's world, innovation, collaboration, and mentorship converge to redefine the boundaries of achievement in the realm of software engineering.

Leveraging his journey as inspiration, he aspires to empower others to navigate their unique paths to success.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Converted 70% lines of JavaScript to Typescript, resulting in a 25% increase of code readability and scalability when implementing further features for the flagship website
- Participated with a SCRUM team, contributing to the maintenance and release of new features on the flagship website, flipboard.com, ensuring seamless integration of cutting-edge functionalities and enhanced user experiences.
- Developed and executed Cypress.io end-to-end integration tests for  30+ React components, achieving a sustainable pass rate and significantly increasing confidence in the stability of our product
- Collaborated with a cross-functional team on a fast-paced mobile development project using React Native and developed a scalable architecture that allowed for easy integration of future design elements
- Deployed additional security measures, such as Google reCATPCHA, resulting in an 80% reduction in -bot-based user signups on the website

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Increased revenue by 8.2% through successful rapid A/B testing implementations across Pottery Barn Brands
- Developed and implemented a modern Frontend boilerplate using ES6 JavaScript/Typescript and Adobe Platforms, resulting in increased efficiency for developers across the company during AB tests.
- Collaborated with business stakeholders to enhance features across all brand websites including PotteryBarn, West-Elm and William-Sonoma

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Engineer, UI Developer 
•	Taken the role of Lead Frontend Engineer to modernize legacy implemention from jQuery to React framework
•	Surveyed and analyzed various open-source modules for integrating automated functional testing using Selenium to facilitate Wells Fargo’s programs.
•	Upgraded Javascript code to comply with web accessibility (WebAIM's WCAG 2.0) including ARIA specifications, HTML semantic elements and focus tab order.
•	Assisted in establishing business standards in Wells Fargo’s new application for sales and servicing, which was delivered less than 6 months ETA.

positions.title: Sales Engineer
positions.description:
Diagnosed and operated Lasertec’s Wafer Measuring tools for customers including Micron, Photronics NANO FAB, MP Mask, CREE and SEMATCH

•	Generated nearly $2 million in revenue for company through successfully closing major deal with Micron Technology in integrating BGM300 wafer-measuring tool into their manufacturing process.
•	Minimized downtime by ~70% for clients by providing technical training sessions for them to understand the Lasertec product line including documentation, data and equipment use.
•       Improved Lasertec product UX by collaborating  and surveying industry leading semiconductor companies.
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-functional Team Leadership · Stakeholder Management

positions.title: Student Intern at Electric & Water GIS Departments
positions.description:
Electrical Engineer Intern at Electric & Water GIS departments
•	Provided and managed the Electric GIS department on map-based resource analysis projects using ArcGIS software.
•	Helped consolidate various GIS project files into the main network in the Water GIS department.
•	Worked with fellow coworkers in the field to learn and gain real world experience in clean technology project development.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Experience- Machine Learning Techniques
positions.description:
Supervision under Dr. Michael Georgiopoulos & Dr. Gita Sukthankar
•	Performed 10+ simulations in Java based on publication results to locate experiment errors in IEEE literature.
•	Improved AI performance by 50% on detecting enemy location using reinforcement learning and propagation techniques in Java and MATLAB for application to real-world video games.

volunteerExperiences.description: Raised funds at the annual dinner to support day laborers in the Portland, Oregon community.

- Pair programmed with 10+ students on technologies such as JavaScript, ReactJS, Redux, Node.js, CSS3, and HTML5, teaching best practices and OOP design principles
- Lectured on data structures (linked list, binary search tree) and algorithm design principles to >50 engineers
- Recognized as one of the top contributors award winners in 2018 (https://medium.freecodecamp.org/announcing-our-freecodecamp-2018-top-contributor-award-winners-861da08a77e1)

projects.title: Financial Health Conversation Tool (FHCT) Application
projects.description:
Internal web-based banker tool that is easy for bankers in Wells Fargo to use as they provide savings consultations to customers.
-Designed and shaped over 30+ re-usable React components to meet Well Fargo’s business requirements and ADA website compliance.
-Assembled robust pre-fill form field engine using JavaScript to match 200+ fields inputs (including dynamic fields) to improve efficiency by 75% when initializing app from CMS (content management system).
-Authored 10+ UI designs with developers/UX designers to create a more intuitive user experience to navigate easier including modals, calculators, field-validation and form-handling.
